product_metadata.title: Sunbeam, White, GCSBC Classic 1200 Watt Mid-size Anti-Drip Non-Stick Soleplate Iron Steam/Vertical Shot feature and 8' 360-degree Swivel Cord, Clear, GCSBCL-317-000
features: MORE POWER: Classic Steam Iron comes equipped with 1200 Watts of power for quick heating
POWERFUL SHOT OF STEAM FEATURE: works horizontally or vertically for hanging garments, upholstery, or drapery
SPRAY MIST FEATURE: the spray mist feature helps smooth out even the toughest wrinkles
NON-STICK SOLEPLATE: mid-size nonstick soleplate glides smoothly across fabrics
AUTO-SHUT OFF: equipped with a 30 minute auto-off feature for added safety and peace of mind
EASY TO MANEUVER: the 8-foot 360° swivel cord allows for freedom of movement while ironing
NO LEAKS, NO WORRY: water tank 170ml equipped with an Anti-Drip system for mess-free ironing,
ACCURATE PRECISION: precision tip gets in between buttons, lapels and around collars when using iron for clothes
description: Sunbeam Classic 1200W Steam Iron is efficient and easy to use. The Shot of Steam feature provides an extra burst of steam to help smooth out stubborn wrinkles on both flat surfaces and vertically on hanging garments. The anti-drip system prevents water leakage to eliminate unwanted drips. The Classic Steam Iron offers 5 fabric settings and 3 steam select settings. The durable non-stick soleplate surface glides over fabrics and smoothes out wrinkles quickly and efficiently. Featuring a 3-way motion smart auto-off automatically shuts the iron off if left unattended or set in an improper position.
